record_title: Exact size and enumeration of maximum length-five non-overlapping codes
provenance: Symbolic solution of the exact SQN(q,5) integer formulation for maximum q-ary non-overlapping codes, with equality classification, enumeration via Proposition 11, and finite exact verification.
limitations: The result is specific to block length five and relies on the published SQN characterization of maximum non-overlapping codes. Originality is to the best of our knowledge after checking equivalent terminology, stronger formulations, later constrained and overlap-free literature, and potentially conflicting ternary maximality claims.
